C201.notes: SER AF-NG-001. Photo · value side 10 · two oil palms · kobo · user year 1976 (date on arms side not shown). Mid-70s oil-boom pocket change — market / taxi / street-stall weight. Country #30 — first Nigeria / first West Africa. SER sibling continent: AF-ER-001. Nigeria flips now 1.
C201.story: A 1976 10 kobo from Nigeria. The obverse shows national arms; the reverse shows value 10; two oil palms, kobo, date on arms side. Struck in cupronickel.
